gaps.text: Some routes declared in code show a screen the map could not place, so those screens are not on it.
gaps.detail: 1 route · 1 named by more than one component

gaps.text: A few of the pages reach no code that reads data or calls an API: static screens, or data loaded in a way the map cannot follow.
About half of the code groups are used by no page this map can follow (background jobs, webhooks, other apps, or calls built at runtime), so they belong to no section.
Part of the product's own backend is in another repository.
gaps.detail: Routes of its backend are called from here and answered by no repository of this project, so what they do is not on the map: /api/assets, /api/assets/*, /api/auth/callback/*, and 10 more.

gaps.text: Redis is a data library this map cannot read yet, so the data kept through it is missing from the Data floor.
Most of the components with an id are rendered by no page this map can follow (a page outside the menu, a screen opened at runtime, or unused), so they are listed under their code only.
Some links in the code are missing: imports of the product's own code that resolve to no file, and calls to /api/… that match no route handler here.
